title: Core character registry + CLI cutover (ADR 0012 continuity/custody)
description:
Implements the cross-campaign half of the character-sheet authority model, and records the decision as ADR 0012 IN THIS PR (no separate ADR PR).

ADR 0012 (folded in): a character is a cross-campaign continuing entity; campaigns are episodes that take CUSTODY during play. The data-root character registry is the authority BETWEEN campaigns; a campaign's character_sheet row (eshyra-lupf.14.1) is the authoritative playable instance DURING play. Attach/import is copy-with-provenance, NOT a silent clone. Revisions, exit/sync-back, double-attach prevention, and the lore chronicle are deferred. Currency is a known sheet gap (eshyra-lupf.15). Cross-pack still fails closed.

Implementation:
- Add a core-owned CharacterRegistryStore backed by a data-root SQLite DB (e.g. <dataRoot>/characters.db), keyed by a stable globalCharacterId, persisting the CharacterSheet document with binding columns (schema_version/system/rules_pack_id) + created_at/updated_at. Named distinctly from the per-campaign CharacterSheetStore; may share low-level helpers.
- One-time importer: migrate legacy <dataRoot>/characters/*.json into the registry.
- Rewire the CLI: standalone create-character writes the registry; import/attach reads the registry, asserts pack match, copies the sheet into the campaign character_sheet table, projects identity/class/level/hp_max into the live character row (importFinalizedCharacter), and stamps globalCharacterId provenance on the campaign sheet.
- Remove the deprecated FinalizedCharacter alias; consumers use CharacterSheet.
- Do NOT build revisions/custody-sync/fork (eshyra-lupf.14.3) or the chronicle (eshyra-lupf.16).
acceptance_criteria:
- ADR 0012 records the continuity/custody model (registry=between-campaign authority; campaign character_sheet=during-play; attach=copy-with-provenance not clone; revisions/sync + chronicle deferred; currency a known gap; cross-pack fails closed).
- Core CharacterRegistryStore (data-root SQLite) persists sheets keyed by a stable globalCharacterId and replaces CLI JSON authority.
- Legacy <root>/characters/*.json are migrated into the registry.
- CLI create/import are wired to the registry; attach copies the sheet into the campaign character_sheet, projects the live row, and stamps globalCharacterId provenance.
- FinalizedCharacter alias removed; consumers use CharacterSheet.
- Pack mismatch fails closed on attach.
- Tests cover registry round-trip, JSON migration, attach+provenance, and pack-mismatch.
notes: PR #328 (https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/328). ADR 0012 + CharacterRegistryStore + attachCharacterSheetToCampaign + CLI cutover + legacy-JSON migration; FinalizedCharacter alias removed. Open for review; close on merge.
